title: Bitnami Spark distribution removal: docker.io/bitnami/spark publishes no tags; the 936 recorded tags (859 version-like) live in docker.io/bitnamilegacy/spark
summary: Under the Bitnami catalog change effective 2025-08-28 (deletion of the docker.io/bitnami public catalog, postponed to 2025-09-29 after feedback), docker.io/bitnami/spark now answers with an empty tag set: no latest, no versioned tags, no digest tags. Every historical Spark version (2, 2.4.3-r3..r81, 3.x, 3.5.4-debian-12-r0..r6, 4.0.0-debian-12-r0..r20, ...) now lives only in docker.io/bitnamilegacy/spark (936 tags total, 859 version-like, no further updates or support). A pinned docker.io/bitnami/spark:<version> reference no longer resolves; a pinned docker.io/bitnamilegacy/spark:<version> reference resolves against a frozen, unsupported snapshot. Production use requires Bitnami Secure Images or an own-registry copy.

evidences.excerpt: Upcoming changes to the Bitnami catalog (effective August 28th, 2025): disable Debian-based image generation, move existing versioned tags to Bitnami Legacy repository (docker.io/bitnamilegacy) with no further updates or support; deletion postponed to September 29th with brownouts Aug 28, Sep 2, Sep 17.

Registry observation 2026-10-07: docker.io/bitnami/spark serves an empty tag set (Hub count 0; registry v2 tags/list returns []). docker.io/bitnamilegacy/spark serves 936 tags, 859 version-like (latest, 2, 2.4.3-r3..r81, 3.x, 4.0.0-debian-12-r0..r20, ...) with digests recorded for all 936 (Hub digest pages + v2 union), no pushes since 2025-08-08 per tag_last_pushed. The split rule fires on the producer path: an empty mainline probe paired with a legacy namespace holding versioned tags is a distribution-model change, not just a missing-repo 404.
